En 2008 se descubrió que una distribució: In 2008 it was discovered that a Linux distribution had spent two years generating keys with a generator from which almost all the source of randomness had been removed by mistake: only some 15 bits of entropy were left, about 32,000 possible keys in all, and they were all recomputed in hours. In 2012 a study of millions of public keys on the internet found tens of thousands that shared factors, because the devices that generated them started up with almost the same seed. And in casinos, more than one player has emptied slot machines by predicting their congruential generator. Bad randomness is the most frequent cause of failure in systems whose mathematics was impeccable.

John von Neumann, que propuso en 1946 un: John von Neumann, who proposed one of the first generators in 1946, said that anyone who tries to produce randomness by arithmetic methods is, of course, living in sin. Derrick Lehmer published the linear congruential generator in 1949, and George Marsaglia proved in 1968 that its points fall on a few planes, the result the demo shows. Arnold Reinhold published the diceware list in 1995. And the official password guidelines, which for twenty years demanded odd symbols and frequent changes, switched in 2017 to asking for length and randomness, after finding that the old rules produced worse passwords.
La [[cr-vernam|libreta de un solo uso]]: The [[cr-vernam|one-time pad]] demanded a “genuinely random” key, and since the first topic keys have been counted to measure a system's strength. This topic joins the two things with the [[fn-exp-log|base-2 logarithm]] and Shannon's [[av-informacion|entropy]]: how many bits of surprise a key has, and where they come from.
La demo calcula lo que valdría la contra: The demo computes what the password would be worth if each symbol were random. But people do not choose at random: “Barcelona1992!” has fourteen symbols of four types, some 90 bits by the formula, and an attacker with a list of cities and years finds it in seconds.
